snippet.title: Crimson Rest: First look trailer
snippet.description:
Here’s the first-look trailer for my dark fantasy game, Crimson Rest. I’ve tried to showcase all the work I’ve done so far, and it finally feels like the game is really coming together. What do you think?

🔗Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3993140?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=firstlook

Follow me @redllamagames for more!
